mapper.insert: insert into media_scan_job (type, status, total, done, started_at) values (#{type}, #{status}, 0, 0, now())
mapper.select: select count(*) from media_scan_job where status = 'running'
select id, type, status, total, done, started_at, finished_at, log from media_scan_job order by id desc limit 1
select id, type, status, total, done, started_at, finished_at from media_scan_job order by id desc limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update media_scan_job set total = #{total}, done = #{done} where id = #{id}
